name: Spider-Man

advantages.name: Agile Feint
advantages.desc: Can use Acrobatics skill check instead of Deception to feint in combat.

advantages.name: Defensive Roll
advantages.desc: +2 active Toughness defense bonus while not defenseless.

advantages.name: Evasion
advantages.desc: +2 bonus to Dodge checks to avoid Area attacks.

advantages.name: Equipment
advantages.desc: 5 Equipment Points for camera, utility belt, and Spider-tracers.

advantages.name: Great Endurance
advantages.desc: +2 bonus on checks against fatigue, starvation, suffocation, and extreme temperatures.

advantages.name: Improved Initiative
advantages.desc: +8 circumstance bonus on initiative checks (+16 total initiative).

advantages.name: Move-by Action
advantages.desc: Can move both before and after a standard action during a turn.

advantages.name: Taunt
advantages.desc: Can demoralize opponents in combat using Deception with witty quips instead of Intimidation.

advantages.name: Uncanny Dodge
advantages.desc: Retains active Dodge and Parry defense even when surprised or flat-footed.

powers.name: Spider-Sense
powers.notes: Danger Sense (Mental Awareness), provides warning of immediate threats.

powers.name: Wall-Crawling
powers.notes: Full speed clinging and climbing along walls, glass, and ceilings.

powers.name: Superhuman Leaping
powers.notes: Leap up to 60 feet in a single bound.

powers.name: Web-Shooters
powers.notes: Web-Snare: 1st Degree: Hindered & Vulnerable, 2nd Degree: Defenseless & Immobile. Resisted by Dodge/DC 20.

powers.name: Web-Slinging
powers.notes: Swinging rank 2: 30 mph, 500 ft/round through city canyons.

resources.name: Compact Digital Camera
resources.desc: Equipped with automatic motion sensor and web-clamp for high-angle action photography.

resources.name: Spider-Tracers & Receiver
resources.desc: Micro-transmitters tuned to Peter's unique Spider-Sense frequency.

resources.name: Utility Belt & Extra Web Cartridges
resources.desc: Spare fluid cartridges, mini-flashlight, and emergency recharger.

notes:
Motivation: Responsibility — "With great power there must also come great responsibility."

Complications:
• Secret Identity: Peter Parker — Dedicated to shielding his beloved Aunt May, Mary Jane Watson, and friends from retaliatory supervillain attacks.
• Relationship & Guilt: Haunted by the memory and loss of Uncle Ben; perpetually torn between personal happiness and civic duty.
• Rogue's Gallery: Relentlessly targeted by archenemies including the Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, Kraven the Hunter, and Venom.
• Daily Bugle & Public Scrutiny: Frequently framed as a masked vigilante menace by publisher J. Jonah Jameson, making heroics politically fraught.
